'''Point Gold''' was an under-construction [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] battery, that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nizon]].

==History==
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on [[Nizon]] shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they began constrution of Point Gold, which they planned to use to shoot rogue [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] out of the sky. [[Vril Vrakth]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] traveled to Nizon in persuit of a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents and the Imperial forces allowed him to use a platfrom at Point Gold as his base of operations. During the [[Battle of Nizon]], he lured the Resistance agents to his platform, but was defeated by them.
